text: {"sql":"SELECT c.level, SUM(oi.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY c.level ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC","unanswerable":false,"unanswerableReason":""}
